Availability and payment options

Paid support is subject to Founder suitability, capacity, and availability review. International clients may be accepted for online support. After written permission to pay, local clients receive bank-transfer details for APC's Maybank business account or DuitNow QR details. International clients receive bank-transfer details through Wise. Payment details are always sent privately.

How booking and payment work

The Founder first reviews suitability, capacity, and availability and gives explicit written permission before payment. Local Maybank bank-transfer or DuitNow QR details, or international Wise bank-transfer details, are sent privately only after permission. Send payment proof through the private channel provided. CJ verifies payment before confirming the booking. A request, payment, or proof is not automatic confirmation.
